description: Create and/or update up to 300 Marketo opportunity role records in one batch (POST /rest/v1/opportunities/roles.json). action is createOrUpdate (default), createOnly or updateOnly; dedupe_by is dedupeFields (externalOpportunityId + leadId + role) or idField (marketoGUID). Async write: poll check_marketo_job_status for per-record status and reasons. Vendor RBAC decides what the API user may write.
embedding_description: Create or update Marketo opportunity roles linking a lead to an opportunity, up to 300 per batch, with createOrUpdate, createOnly or updateOnly. Async write returns Marketo's per-record created, updated or skipped status with reasons. Keyed by externalOpportunityId + leadId + role, or marketoGUID. Distinct from delete_opportunity_roles, which removes opportunity roles.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo opportunity roles sync job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id and status 'queued'. The completed job result is Marketo's per-record results array (seq, id or marketoGUID, status, reasons), row_count and tallies (status -> count).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This changes vendor state. A queued job is not vendor success: poll check_marketo_job_status, then report the tallies and any skipped records with their reasons.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create or update Marketo opportunity roles on the configured instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: refused at dispatch before any vendor call (missing or malformed parameters, more than 300 entries, an action/dedupe_by/delete_by value Marketo does not define). On the finished job: marketo.permission_denied (vendor 603 or HTTP 403) means the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission; marketo.auth_failed (601/602 after one re-mint, or HTTP 401) means the credential was rejected; marketo.validation_failed and other vendor codes carry Marketo's own message. A transport fault after dispatch may follow a vendor mutation.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.permission_denied: grant Read-Write Opportunity under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > the API role > Access API, then retry. Adobe documents some Lead Database object APIs as unavailable on subscriptions with a native CRM sync; that vendor error is reported as returned. Read the records back with get_opportunity_roles before retrying a write that ended in a transport fault.
